entry.title: Stallord skip with displacement clip (Sidehop method)

media:group.media:title: Stallord skip with displacement clip (Sidehop method)
media:group.media:description:
For documentation, if you need more info about the trick and its steps go to https://www.zeldaspeedruns.com/tp/boss/stallord.
Troubleshooting: When doing this method you will find that you end up at slightly different X-positions, but as long as the steps were done correctly it should still work. The finicky part is that you need to aim to press B not too close to the spinner track, nor too far. If too close you will end up with a x-position around ~30 which is far off and will not work, while if you're too far your sword will hit the wall. Note that you can walk forward and then jumpslash if you're too far, but this usually ends up in a x-position that won't work.
Keep these things in mind when doing this method: - Hold ESS for the sidehops to not accidentally move - Cancel the spinner with B (to pull sword) as Link's head is lined up with the spinner track, might need to find your own visual cue if it doesn't work. - ESS sidehop right ASAP after canceling the spinner as you can't sidehop if you sink into the sand - Jumpslash and combo slash twice ASAP, if you wait slightly it'll give you a bad position (For example z-pos: -4035 instead of -4033 that you want)
After this is done you want to have a z-pos of -4033 and x-pos of around 55.9-57.0x. Do remember that the positions will vary slightly depending on which frame you do your movement.

media:group.media:title: Alternative lava leap setup (No sword)
media:group.media:description:
I find this one to be easier for the sidehop at the end, but I haven't done any actual frame data on that. It doesn't require a sword.
1. Target hookshot target, sidehop right and target the wall 2. Backflip x2, roll and ess left x2 to 0x8e10. Hold target and roll, hold up ASAP after starting the roll, not before. The important part is to start the roll with just target and A. You will most likely get different positions here, but it's likely that it will work, I rarely fail it keeping the roll thing in mind + waiting for camera if possible. 3. Aim up, make sure you start with a full down input, that's why I shoot the hookshot. You can also pause for it. Notice where the red reticle is during the first pause, that's where you want to stop. 4. Hold left and tap hookshot, pause buffer until the chain is out. 5. Pause until the timer reaches 0 and Link dies 6. Hold down until around when the room transitions (not precise) and then hold down-left for around 1.5s and finally hold left to sidehop at the peak of the jump. If you're lucky with your notches you might just need to hold down-left the the entire time.

entry.title: Wrong warp to Light Arrow Cutscene from Deku Tree and turn adult (For 100%)

media:group.media:title: Wrong warp to Light Arrow Cutscene from Deku Tree and turn adult (For 100%)
media:group.media:description:
Note: This video uses quicktext on GZ but it doesn't make a difference for the setup itself, just to make the pain for testing etc. less.
Big shoutsout to natalyahasdied who helped me figure out how it works and to find angles and values that work!
Watches used and explained: 801CAAC8 x32: Shows the cutscene pointer value. Should read 801FA0A0 after saying yes to Deku Tree in step 3. 801DB40C: Allocations for actor held in hand, this is the heap value we manip to read 801FA0A0 when pulling the bombchu in step 8. Basically puts the value of a bombchu into the cutscene pointer's value which then will run as a failed command; this in turn makes the cutscene pointer value skip 0x30 * your angle which eventually hits the flashback cutscene. (There's some more math to this but I'm too dumb for it) 801FA0A0: The value we want for our cutscene pointer. Should read da03ff when pulling the second bombchu in step 8.
Keep in mind that this is fit for 100% and depending on which rupees you pick up in Kokiri forest will affect the setup and result. Explanation and important steps for the wrong warp will be listed below, other tricks that's not relevant to it won't be explained.
Make sure to grab the normal rupees for a 100% speedrun at the start as this will affect the trick (see normal 100% speedrun, they do it there). For this version of the trick you should also have met Zelda and gotten the lullaby as this removes Mido guarding the path to Deku Tree. If those conditions aren't met you could however use a different setup posted below, but it needs to use the angles 6ea3 or 6eb3 when you drop the second bombchu and I don't show this setup here.
1. Enter deku tree without watching the cutscene. The cutscene of Deku Tree opening it's mouth will be used to set the correct cutscene pointer value and if you haven't cleared the deku tree intro cutscene your cutscene pointer's value will change later on.
2. Exit and go through text, say no when prompted to enter.
3. Reload area 3 times and take damage. Go back to Deku Tree and answer yes to enter. - Get down to ½ heart during the setup, when you do it doesn't matter, it's to deathwarp later.
4. Slash sign as shown
5. Climb fence for angle, sidehop left
6. ESS left to 0x36f9, ESS up to get the angle 0x36fe. ESS right until the angle 0x7926
7. Hold target and drop bugs; this prevents the camera from turning the wrong way (you want it pointing towards the shop)
8. Pull and drop chu x2, when you drop the second bombchu you should still have the angle 0x7926 and the watch 801FA0A0 should read da03ff while 801DB40C should read 801FA0A0. Deathwarp after this, you can pull another bombchu and it shouldn't mess up the setup.
9. Go through Deku Tree. There might be a problem with actually going through B1 and not skipping it but nothing I've confirmed. Video just does it like 100% (might?) do it, but it's not required to get the slingshot and so.
10. Kill gohma and take damage, I forgot to take damage in the video but it doesn't matter for the setup.
11. Death wrong warp setup. Ganondoor might work but did not confirm.
Pausing inside Gohma's room does NOT matter like it might for other instances.
Bliny's setup (video by Count): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1uW5DlJP2Bs

media:group.media:title: Faster Door of Time skip as child
media:group.media:description:
1. Stop your backwalk as you walk over the first black line on the floor after going up the steps. You should end up around the the black line before reaching the wall. 2. ESS turn left x4 3. Target, turn left and target
You can also backwalk all the way into the door, roll and then do the rest of the setup for a consistent position.

entry.title: Alternate Door of Time skip setup

media:group.media:title: Alternate Door of Time skip setup
media:group.media:description:
Inspired by Cabbage's setup: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=76mENmgcSI4
Possible to do swordless if you hold right before the clip, but it still has only one frame that works.
1. Get in corner 2. Sidehop sideroll 3. Sidehop, ESS up 4. Target and then turn left 5. Jumpslash while holding right for most working frames
Keep in mind that you have to target before turning left or you'll get the wrong angle.
